Chinese researchers have reviewed the potential of zwitterions to improve the efficiency and stability of perovskite solar cells through defect passivation, crystallization control, and interface engineering. They found that these compounds could also enhance charge extraction, stabilize the perovskite structure, and suppress ion migration and electrode degradation.

sources.title: Retractable photovoltaics for wastewater treatment
sources.excerpt:
Germany’s largest retractable solar roof, with a capacity of 2.745 MW, is under construction at a wastewater treatment plant in Stuttgart. Scheduled for completion in 2027, the system will generate more than 2.2 GWh annually, covering around 9% of the plant’s electricity demand.
